purpose: Portable contract for storing, comparing, and later contributing pre-commitment decision evidence without presenting modeled values as verified facts.

evidence_classes.user: Directly supplied or corrected by the user.
evidence_classes.public: Observed in an identifiable public source but not independently verified by ExpenseIntel.
evidence_classes.verified: Supported by a directly inspectable source or user-provided document with field-level provenance.
evidence_classes.modeled: Estimated from a model, baseline, comparable set, or heuristic.
evidence_classes.unknown: Material field with insufficient evidence to estimate responsibly.

freshness.rule: Freshness is source-specific and must not be inferred from retrieval time alone.

fields.evidence_id: stable identifier for this evidence record
fields.source_id: identifier from the ExpenseIntel source catalog when applicable
fields.category: vehicle | lease | property | home | equipment | business-project | personal
fields.subject: normalized item, project, property, quote, or commitment
fields.source_uri: optional listing, quote, document, or public source
fields.observed_at: when the underlying evidence was observed
fields.retrieved_at: when ExpenseIntel retrieved or parsed it
fields.field: price, rate, recurring cost, term, tax, insurance, residual value, lead time, etc.
fields.unit: currency, percent, months, annual, monthly, etc.
fields.confidence: 0-100 evidence confidence, separate from recommendation quality
fields.method: direct input, parser, public source, comparable set, model, or user correction
fields.quality_flags: zero or more explicit quality flags
fields.replaced_by: newer evidence record when an assumption is superseded
fields.outcome_value: optional realized value after the decision

rules: User-entered numbers always supersede modeled baselines for the same field unless the user explicitly restores the model value.
A modeled value may guide planning but must never be presented as a quote or verified market fact.
Comparable claims require an identifiable comparable set or public source.
Observation time and retrieval time are distinct.
Conflicting evidence must remain visible until resolved; do not silently choose a winner.
Stale evidence must retain its original observation date and carry an explicit freshness flag.
Unknown is a valid output when evidence is insufficient.
Outcome data is opt-in and must remain distinguishable from modeled recommendations.
